state.objective: Review every remaining receivable, payable, party and customer-advance family in the client COA for dimensional compression.
confirmed_context: One PT Perorangan owns HO and all operating sites; site_id is a dimension.
Customer, employee, supplier, acquirer, invoice, PO and GRN can be represented in controlled subledgers.
Party identity may move out of the natural account, but asset, liability, allowance, clearing/suspense and income/expense natures must remain distinguishable.
No balances, aging, contracts, settlement workflows or posting samples are supplied, so all merges require reconciliation gates.

actual_families.other_payable_site_14: Other Payable repeated for HO and 13 operating-site names
actual_families.principal_site_14: Other Payable Principal repeated for HO and 13 operating-site names

card_receivable.instructions: Can credit-card and debit-card receivables use one Card/Acquirer Receivable control GL with tender_type and acquirer_id?

criteria.conditional: Yes if settlement timing, fees, chargebacks and reconciliation remain reportable.

employee_receivable.instructions: Can employee, store-manager and management receivables use one Employee/Related-person Receivable control GL with person_id and role_type?

criteria.conditional: Yes if terms, authorization, tax/disclosure and aging are controlled.

receivable_allowance.instructions: Can three allowance/write-off families become fewer allowance control GLs with receivable_class detail?

criteria.conditional: Yes if expected-loss/write-off methodology and presentation align; keep allowance separate from gross receivable.
criteria.retain3: Every receivable class must be a GL.
criteria.gross: Net postings directly into gross receivables.

allowance_vs_writeoff.instructions: Does an account label combining allowance and write-off require transaction review before final mapping?

criteria.yes: Provision balance and actual write-off are different events and may need separate posting logic.
criteria.no: The combined label proves one treatment.

supplier_two.instructions: Can merchandise and non-merchandise supplier payables become one Supplier Payable control GL solely because supplier_id exists?

criteria.review: Purchasing, inventory matching, tax, reporting and settlement differences may justify separate trade classes.
criteria.always2: They can never share a control account.

supplier_identity.instructions: Should individual supplier names be encoded in natural GL accounts?

criteria.subledger: Use supplier_id and invoice in AP subledger.

grn_suspense.instructions: Should Merchandise Supplier Payable-Suspend remain separate from confirmed supplier payable while unmatched receipt/invoice timing exists?

criteria.separate: Use a controlled GRNI/suspense account with PO/GRN matching and aging.
criteria.merge: Merge into confirmed AP without matching status.

other_payable_14.instructions: Because all sites belong to one PT, can 14 site-named Other Payable families become one Other Payable control GL with site_id and party/liability type?

criteria.conditional: Yes after confirming the name is site attribution rather than distinct legal counterparty.

other_payable_control.instructions: Should Other Payable become an unrestricted catch-all account?

criteria.no: Require liability_type, party/document, approval, aging and periodic review.
criteria.yes: Use it as the default for all liabilities.

sales_advance.instructions: Must Sales Advance remain a liability distinct from revenue until performance/redemption/refund conditions are met?

criteria.liability: Keep contract/customer-advance liability with customer/voucher/order detail.

principal_site_14.instructions: Can 14 site-named Other Payable Principal families be compressed solely because all sites are one PT?

criteria.review: First identify who Principal is and whether balances are owner loans, financing, historical interunit balances or another liability.
criteria.equity: Treat all as owner equity immediately.

principal_owner.instructions: Does the word Principal prove the creditor is the PT Perorangan owner?

criteria.no: Verify legal creditor, agreement, settlement and subordination.
criteria.yes: Classify as owner loan solely from label.

party_master.instructions: Should employee, supplier, customer, acquirer and legal creditor share one undifferentiated party role?

criteria.roles: A party master may be shared, but role-specific subledgers and controls remain explicit.
criteria.gl: Avoid party master and encode names in GL.

criteria.full: Aging, balances, party masters, settlement/chargeback, PO-GRN-invoice matching, contracts, transaction samples and subledger-to-GL reconciliation.

next_domain.instructions: After party working-capital accounts, which remaining domain should be reviewed next?

criteria.sales_cash: Cash, tender/acquirer, sales channels, discounts, returns and other income.
criteria.equity_close: Owner equity and closing accounts only.
criteria.stop: Stop before all accounts are reviewed.
